meta.name: lead-capture
meta.description: Converts anonymous traffic into known contacts — lead magnets, gated content, free tools, popups, and the forms behind them. Use this to design or improve a lead magnet, plan a free tool, add or fix popups and overlays, improve form conversion, or decide what is worth gating and what should stay open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把匿名访客变成可跟进的潜在客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做网站或落地页,想把访问者转化为可联系的销售线索。
copy.tagline_en: Turn anonymous visitors into trackable leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to turn visitors into sales leads.

howto.what: Claude会按该技能给建议：什么内容该设门槛（如模板、计算器）什么不该；怎么设计诱饵和免费工具；弹窗按行为触发且不重复打扰；表单字段能少就少。
howto.when: 当你想设计或改进换取邮箱的资料/工具、处理弹窗和覆盖层，或优化表单转化等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我想一个能用来换邮箱的免费资源或工具。
say.note: 它会按“值得付费”标准帮你筛点子。

say.text: 网站弹窗应该什么时候出现、出现几次不招人烦？
say.note: 它会按行为触发、只弹一次等规则来改。

say.text: 表单上有哪些字段可以删掉？为什么？
say.note: 它会按“下一步需要什么”来删字段。

howto.what_en: Claude will advise: gate useful tools, keep other content open; design lead magnets/free tools; use behavior-based popups and minimal forms.
howto.when_en: When you ask to design or improve an email-capturing asset or free tool, handle popups/overlays, or optimize form conversion, it applies this skill.

say_en.text: Help me think of a free resource or tool worth asking for an email address.
say_en.note: It will screen ideas using a 'worth paying a little' test.

say_en.text: When should the popup show, and how often without annoying people?
say_en.note: Behavior triggers, once per visitor, clear dismissals.

say_en.text: Which form fields can I cut, and why?
say_en.note: It trims fields to only what the next step needs.
